$comment: PR review risk tiering. Read by ~/.claude/hooks/pr-review-policy.sh.
Any file matching 'high' => HIGH (Gitar + CodeRabbit). All files matching 'low' => LOW.
Everything else => NORMAL (Gitar only). No match anywhere => NORMAL, deliberately.
Monorepo: apps/dashboard consumes packages/ci-frontend, which is PUBLISHED to a
registry (release.yml). Every package.json is therefore HIGH - a version or
dependency change here propagates to external consumers, not just to this build.
LOW justification for THIS repo: only ROOT *.md and docs/ are low. Markdown inside
packages/** is NOT low - a readme can be shipped inside the published npm tarball.
The '*' in '*.md' does not cross a directory separator, so packages/**/*.md is
correctly excluded; do not 'tidy' this into '**/*.md'.
